This is why opinion editors for national publications receive hundreds of emails a day pitching opinion pieces.","properties":{"paragraphType":"lead"}},{"id":"63f95b00","type":"_paragraph","value":"However, the reality is that most of these articles and ideas for articles do not get published - partly because space is so limited for them."},{"id":"d31aa3dd","type":"_paragraph","value":"This should not discourage you from pitching your idea if you believe you have something important to say. However, you should do it in a way that’s most likely to get it read and create the least work for you and the editor who reads it."},{"id":"4e83598a","type":"_heading","value":[{"id":"ccfc28eb","type":"_fragment","value":"Cutting through the noise","properties":{"decorators":["strong"]}}],"properties":{"level":3}},{"id":"daaa84f5","type":"_list","value":[{"id":"d77c4b56","type":"_listItem","value":"When pitching your idea, you should generally email the opinion or comment editor not the journalist who specialises in the area you want to write about. Their details should be available on the publication's website, but LSE's media relations team can help you if you can't find them."},{"id":"67537e1a","type":"_listItem","value":"Approach the news outlet that is most likely to publish your piece, given their political persuasion and the issue you wish to cover."},{"id":"abd699ca","type":"_listItem","value":"In your email introduce yourself and your credentials. Explain why you have the expertise to write about the issue you are proposing to cover. This should be no more than one or two lines."},{"id":"3fee61f","type":"_listItem","value":"Write a brief outline of what argument you are going to make in the piece in a concise way, so it can be assessed quickly. We recommend doing this using three to four bullet points so it’s easier for an editor to scan. Remember to explain why the piece is timely or ‘news’ if it is not apparent."},{"id":"e9d92e52","type":"_listItem","value":"Include contact details for how the publication can get hold of you quickly if necessary."}],"properties":{"listType":"unordered"}},{"id":"1f5c1a92","type":"_heading","value":[{"id":"e72df68d","type":"_fragment","value":"Things to avoid","properties":{"decorators":["strong"]}}],"properties":{"level":3}},{"id":"1fc0ff09","type":"_list","value":[{"id":"24fafd94","type":"_listItem","value":"Be sure that your proposed piece sets out an opinion, rather than an ‘on the one hand, on the other’ survey of the issue."},{"id":"16193f79","type":"_listItem","value":"You should not send a pre-written article speculatively. As detailed above, journalists do not have the time to read these."},{"id":"1b6f9641","type":"_listItem","value":"Don’t use jargon unless you are writing for a specialist publication. The national newspapers and their websites want articles which make good arguments in plain language."},{"id":"4e231c08","type":"_listItem","value":"Don’t wait to pitch your idea if it relates to something in the news. Often a publication will want to run an opinion piece the day after a piece of news has broken."},{"id":"14f80dbf","type":"_listItem","value":"You should not pitch to more than one publication at once. Each publication wants an article exclusively, and if you have already offered it elsewhere, you might be rejected on this basis alone."}],"properties":{"listType":"unordered"}},{"id":"59e3e618","type":"_heading","value":[{"id":"e1d552e4","type":"_fragment","value":"What happens next?","properties":{"decorators":["strong"]}}],"properties":{"level":3}},{"id":"dc7dae8e","type":"_paragraph","value":"Unfortunately, because of the overwhelming amount of emails opinion editors receive, you are unlikely to hear back unless they are interested in following up with you. If you have not heard back within 24 –48 hours, and the idea is still fresh, you can consider pitching it to another publication."},{"id":"205197d3","type":"_paragraph","value":"If the publication does follow up with you, they will likely ask for an article that is 600 – 800 words long. If it’s very timely they may ask for it by the end of the day, or the next day. It’s worth asking yourself if you have time to do this before pitching your article."},{"id":"3ae0e013","type":"_paragraph","value":"The media relations team is very happy to advise you on your draft opinion piece after you have been commissioned."},{"id":"edbfb434","type":"_heading","value":[{"id":"cc266f01","type":"_fragment","value":"Need more help?","properties":{"decorators":["strong"]}}],"properties":{"level":3}},{"id":"bf29b231","type":"_paragraph","value":"Read more guidance about writing for different publications:"},{"id":"d6cef2a6","type":"_paragraph","value":[{"id":"2e6ec848","type":"_link","value":"The Guardian","properties":{"link":{"sys":{"uri":"https:\u002F\u002Fwww.theguardian.com\u002Fcommentisfree\u002F2010\u002Fmar\u002F04\u002Fyou-tell-us","linkProperties":{"type":"uri"}}},"newTab":true}}]},{"id":"57b620bb","type":"_paragraph","value":[{"id":"d59038cf","type":"_link","value":"The Financial Times","properties":{"link":{"sys":{"uri":"https:\u002F\u002Fwww.ft.com\u002Fcontent\u002Fe3e8ff2b-95c7-48f8-9eda-312494422e10","linkProperties":{"type":"uri"}}},"newTab":true}}]},{"id":"9d2a9a57","type":"_paragraph","value":[{"id":"22956f02","type":"_fragment","value":"If you are not sure which publication to pitch your idea to or you would like some more guidance please contact the media relations team who will be happy to help. years, helping to stabilise and grow its programmes. In addition, he was the long-term Director of the Hellenic Observatory, which is internationally acknowledged as a premier centre for work on contemporary Greece and Cyprus."},{"id":"ap6tqvhl","type":"_paragraph","value":[{"id":"h204p00x","type":"_fragment","value":"Commenting on the award, Professor Featherstone said:","properties":{"decorators":["strong"]}},{"id":"1w4hufxk","type":"_fragment","value":" \"An honour like this acknowledges what a fantastic place the LSE is to work in – we are each lifted by our colleagues, and I thank them once again. The award acknowledges my academic work, and my research has focussed primarily on Greece and Europe. I have been intrigued by the domestic responses to the pressures of European Union membership and, latterly, by the capacity of institutions to adapt. The ‘Euro-Zone’ crisis brought many of these issues to the fore, of course, and my upcoming book (once more with Dimitris Papadimitriou) examines crisis management within government in Athens. "}]},{"id":"p6f2qiph","type":"_paragraph","value":"\"In parallel, the award refers to my contributions to ‘UK-Greek’ relations and my public engagement, which has followed my research. In these activities, I have been hugely aided by my colleagues in the LSE’s Hellenic Observatory, creating a capacity for involvement greater than the sum of our parts. The award, then, reflects the empowerment and support we receive from our colleagues and collaborators.\""},{"id":"4v35t37c","type":"_paragraph","value":[{"id":"50gutlhq","type":"_link","value":"Professor Stephan Chambers","properties":{"link":{"entryTitle":"Professor Stephan Chambers","entryDescription":"Director and Professor in Practice","entryThumbnail":{"altText":"Stephan 200x200","caption":null,"transformations":null,"asset":{"entryTitle":"Stephan 200x200","entryDescription":null,"sys":{"id":"040731fe-bbc1-5ea8-8269-0acbe0c0046c","language":"en-GB","contentTypeId":"image","dataFormat":"asset","uri":"\u002Fall-images\u002Fprofile\u002Fstephan-200x200.x9e980a58.jpg"}}},"sys":{"id":"aa5524c7-a2d6-5ac3-b95d-a3768929dca6","language":"en-GB","contentTypeId":"person","dataFormat":"entry","uri":"\u002Fpeople\u002Fstephan-chambers"}}}},{"id":"vqwmasoh","type":"_fragment","value":" has been awarded an OBE in recognition of his contributions to philanthropy and social enterprise."}]},{"id":"h9y9gn51","type":"_paragraph","value":[{"id":"ue955pq0","type":"_fragment","value":"Professor Chambers is the inaugural director of the "},{"id":"tnr5ogx5","type":"_link","value":"Marshall Institute","properties":{"link":null}},{"id":"fnhq354c","type":"_fragment","value":" at LSE. He is also Professor in Practice at the Department of Management and Course Director for the new Executive Masters in Social Business and Entrepreneurship."}]},{"id":"mt1y3lu5","type":"_paragraph","value":[{"id":"yzxylqvn","type":"_fragment","value":"Commenting on the award, he said:","properties":{"decorators":["strong"]}},{"id":"nfpidkg0","type":"_fragment","value":" \"I am deeply honoured to receive this award, but I do so with the belief that it reflects not just my work, but the collective effort of many remarkable colleagues and partners that I’ve had the privilege to work with."}]},{"id":"pwwtq7yi","type":"_paragraph","value":"Philanthropy and social entrepreneurship are, by nature, collaborative endeavours and this recognition is about the progress and impact of the field itself. I hope this honour helps shine a light on the vital work being done across the sector and the positive change it continues to bring to society.\""},{"id":"nfi2bvo4","type":"_paragraph","value":[{"id":"bn19lvr5","type":"_link","value":"Laura-Jane (LJ) Silverman","properties":{"link":{"sys":{"uri":"https:\u002F\u002Finfo.lse.ac.uk\u002Fstaff\u002Fdivisions\u002Fresearch-and-innovation\u002Fgenerate\u002Fteam","linkProperties":{"type":"uri"}}}}},{"id":"2n09ron3","type":"_fragment","value":", the Head of "},{"id":"fy69zc1s","type":"_link","value":"LSE Generate","properties":{"link":{"sys":{"uri":"https:\u002F\u002Finfo.lse.ac.uk\u002Fstaff\u002Fdivisions\u002Fresearch-and-innovation\u002Fgenerate","linkProperties":{"type":"uri"}}}}},{"id":"drhr5c46","type":"_fragment","value":", the School’s hub for entrepreneurship, has been appointed a Member of the Order of the British Empire (MBE) for services to social innovation and education."}]},{"id":"ooh9813u","type":"_paragraph","value":[{"id":"lrtqrsgg","type":"_link","value":"The award-winning","properties":{"link":{"entryTitle":"LSE Generate Named Top UK University Start-up Hub in 2025 Rankings","entryDescription":null,"entryThumbnail":null,"sys":{"id":"a07b269f-2414-5752-9e44-20d895bc6dd7","language":"en-GB","contentTypeId":"newsArticle","dataFormat":"entry","uri":"\u002Fnews\u002Flatest-news-from-lse\u002Fb-february-25\u002Flse-generate-top-uk-university-start-up-hub-2025"}}}},{"id":"4o2r2zxy","type":"_fragment","value":" LSE Generate was built from scratch by LJ in 2018 to support LSE’s students and alumni to develop entrepreneurial skills as they build businesses and innovate in the UK and around the world. Today, LJ manages the entrepreneurship centre in London and its 20 international chapters across the globe."}]},{"id":"wqoizdjm","type":"_paragraph","value":[{"id":"cvjlt0eh","type":"_link","value":"The LSE Generate School’s programme","properties":{"link":{"sys":{"uri":"https:\u002F\u002Finfo.lse.ac.uk\u002Fstaff\u002Fdivisions\u002Fresearch-and-innovation\u002Fgenerate\u002FSchools-Programme","linkProperties":{"type":"uri"}}}}},{"id":"mvkuccqr","type":"_fragment","value":" leverages LSE’s entrepreneurial expertise, cutting-edge research and hands-on mentorship with alumni founders to inspire and prepare young people from diverse backgrounds to become future leaders and changemakers. It has reached over 11,000 students over five continents in the last two years."}]},{"id":"sw55tebr","type":"_paragraph","value":[{"id":"fgq25l5p","type":"_fragment","value":"Commenting on the award, LJ Silverman said: \"","properties":{"decorators":["strong"]}},{"id":"c6xjk1bf","type":"_fragment","value":"I’m utterly astonished and deeply honoured to receive this recognition. It’s a real privilege to do the work I love every day at LSE, surrounded by such an extraordinary team and community. In a world that often feels uncertain, it’s inspiring to know there’s a generation of entrepreneurs rising to meet the moment—innovating not for profit alone, but for the betterment of society."}]},{"id":"erph5cq2","type":"_paragraph","value":"\"What makes LSE so special is its unique blend of critical thinking, social science expertise, and global perspective. It’s a place that doesn’t just educate future leaders, it challenges them to reimagine the world and build ventures with purpose. At LSE Generate, we go a step further by making that entrepreneurial journey radically inclusive. We welcome ideas and founders from all backgrounds, believing that innovation is at its best when everyone has a seat at the table."},{"id":"i502a1rm","type":"_paragraph","value":"\"This honour is not
